table_cells.text: Astone shell wall is built around the motte, also a Great Hall, kitchen and bishop's private apartment (camera)
HughHerland adds scissor beamroof to bishop's camera for BishopWilliamWykeham
Bishop William Waynflete adds brick entrance tower, soon to be extended by Bishop Fox
Tudor wing is added but the exact date is currentlyunknown
Fire demolishes the castle stables whenJamesIis in residence
Civil Warsees Castle change hands from Cromwell's forces to the King's, and back again to the Parliamentarians
Bishop George Morley begins major refurbishment including a newchapel
Bishop Charles Sumner makes changes to the gateway and establishes a garden in the Keep
Bishop Anthony Thorold uses his ownmoneytoupdateandmodernisefacilities at the castle
Farnham Castle and Palace becomes part of the newdiocese of Guildford
Bishop Henry of Blois is said to have built the first stone Keep, but it mayhavebeenconstructed earlier
King Henry II demolishes this initial Keep
AmyAndersonraises moneytosave the castle and refurbish and repair it
Farnham Castle becomes the Centre for International Briefing &nolonger a bishop's residence
Bishop of Guildford, John Grieg moves in following renovations
Bishop Brownlow North begins new, extensive renovations and plants three Lebanon cedars
Anhistoric site to visit and enjoy, and an award-winning wedding venue and conference centre
